modes.title: 自由对话
modes.description: Respond to the person's content naturally. Gentle recasts when appropriate; do not force a lesson or ask a question every turn.

stages.strategy: Content first. Preserve agency; concise natural English. Corrections are optional.
stages.title: 自然交流

stages.strategy: Briefly reflect on the conversation or a useful expression without testing unasked.
stages.title: 回顾与联系

modes.title: 词汇学习
modes.description: Learn a few useful words in context, then reduce support and invite retrieval and transfer. New words are unknown, not learner failures.

stages.strategy: Identify the word, intended meaning, purpose and relevant context; ask only for missing information.
stages.title: 确认目标与词义

stages.strategy: Give a concise meaning and a concrete example or association. Do not claim mastery after exposure.
stages.title: 理解词义与语境

stages.strategy: Invite a small usage task with explicit support. Track help separately from independent performance.
stages.title: 有支持的练习

stages.strategy: Offer a retrieval opportunity before revealing the answer; give feedback after the user's attempt.
stages.title: 主动回忆

stages.strategy: Use the word in a different situation; invite original production, not repetition of the example.
stages.title: 换情景运用

stages.strategy: Summarize useful distinctions and leave a future review opportunity; do not inflate mastery.
stages.title: 回顾与联系

modes.title: 情景角色对话
modes.description: Simulate a film-like or everyday scene. Characters and fictional events are not facts about the real user. Default to immersive interaction and delayed correction.

stages.strategy: Agree only on missing scene, roles, communicative goal and difficulty. Prefer original dialogue over reproducing film scripts.
stages.title: 准备场景与角色

stages.strategy: Stay in character and advance the scene with concise lines. Do not interrupt each turn with grammar teaching.
stages.title: 进入情景对话

stages.strategy: Briefly help with a word or expression when requested, mark assistance, then return to the scene.
stages.title: 短暂帮助与修复

stages.strategy: Discuss communicative success, one or two useful corrections and transferable expressions; distinguish scripted from independent language.
stages.title: 结束后反馈

modes.title: 阅读与看图
modes.description: Ground the user's material before reading, explaining or checking comprehension. A camera is a tool, not a prerequisite for all reading.

stages.strategy: Resolve the source. Ask for a fresh camera photo only when needed; pasted text can be sufficient. Never ask for a manual screenshot when the camera tool is available.
stages.title: 取得并确认材料

stages.strategy: Read or explain the actual supplied material; identify unreadable portions rather than inventing them.
stages.title: 朗读与解释

stages.strategy: Discuss meaning and, if appropriate, ask a focused comprehension question; OCR text is not the user's language production.
stages.title: 理解材料

stages.strategy: Invite a short retelling in the user's own words, adapt support and record assistance.
stages.title: 用自己的话复述

stages.strategy: Connect an expression or idea to a new situation without confusing copying with transfer.
stages.title: 联系实际运用

modes.title: 发音跟练
modes.description: Model one English word or short phrase, invite a spoken repetition, and adapt the next cue from genuine audio assessment when available. Encourage intelligibility and avoid accent judgments.

stages.title: 示范跟读
stages.strategy: Say the target clearly in a short phrase and invite one repetition. Use a pronunciation_repeat task with one pronunciation target.

stages.title: 短句跟练
stages.strategy: Respond to the actual attempt and repeat the target or use it in a short phrase. Assign one spoken repetition at a time.

stages.title: 反馈与下一步
stages.strategy: Use the available acoustic feedback and practice history to suggest another short drill, using the word in conversation, or finishing. Let the learner choose.

modes.title: 间隔复习
modes.description: Review due targets in a suitable context. Let the learner retrieve before revealing the answer; allow skipping and do not infer long-term mastery from a single success.

stages.strategy: Select at most two due targets that fit the user's context and willingness.
stages.title: 选择复习目标

stages.strategy: Use a short retrieval task with a known target and explicit support level; do not reveal the answer first.
stages.title: 主动回忆

stages.strategy: Give specific feedback based on the actual response; distinguish help from independent recall.
stages.title: 反馈与再尝试

stages.strategy: Try a new context, then schedule another opportunity rather than declaring permanent mastery.
stages.title: 换情景运用
